title: Values-Living Gap: Global Values Report 2026
discussion_signal: The post distinguishes stated values from the capacity to live them, connecting family, respect, kindness, and honesty to exhaustion, disconnection, and gendered burdens. It supplies a cultural-meaning signal about the gap between ideals and lived conditions.
linked_research_question: When people’s stated values conflict with lived constraints, how does that gap affect identity, belonging, trust, and social action?
limits: Creator’s own assessment and self-selected respondents
The sample and instrument are not independently evaluated here
Reported associations do not establish causal effects
